details: Supplement to parent coverage: signed formal construction and exact fibres proved; linked and independent signs treated and finite constant group schemes verified for S3,S4,SL2(F3),SL2(Z/4). The final audit separates universal signed realization B.8.5, congruence effective image/kernel B.15, named geometric comparison B.16, the quotient-domain correction B.17 and restricted-conjugator comparisons B.18. This contribution does not reduce every residual to B.8.5.
